name: sct
description: Local projects and encrypted handoffs for macOS.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.node.json && bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.web.json && bun check --no-script -p packages/relay/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:tsc: bun node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && bun node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && bun node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/relay/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run typecheck:tsc && bun run build:sdk && electron-vite build && bun run build:demo && bun run build:airdrop
scripts.build:demo: bun build demo/index.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile out/demo/index.cjs
scripts.build:icon: bun build scripts/build-icon.ts --target node --format esm --external electron --outfile out/build-icon.mjs && electron out/build-icon.mjs
scripts.build:sdk: bun build sdk/src/index.ts --target node --format esm --outfile sdk/dist/index.js && bun node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p sdk/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: cd tests && bun test projects.test.ts vault.test.ts runtime.test.ts sharing.test.ts envelope.test.ts
scripts.test:ui: bun run build && cd tests && playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts
